title: A translational tile with no fully periodic tiling in dimension three
summary: We construct a finite translational tile in ℤ 3 that admits tilings but no fully periodic tiling. Its unit-cube thickening has the same property in ℝ 3 , even when arbitrary real translations are allowed. This gives a negative resolution of the periodic tiling conjecture in dimension three.
family_title: A counterexample to periodic tiling in dimension three

review.reason: Builds a translational tile in dimension three lacking any fully periodic tiling.
